segments.text: Ok so this is the authentication page for AG2, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, the token goes in properties here.
And the page says it gets forwarded as a request header, umm, but it isn't.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
This part, the user token value, wasn't on the page, so I set it to the token the page's own backend accepts.
Moving on to the demo. I asked for the account data, it should answer, but uh, the chat just stays empty.
So basically, the page says the token gets forwarded to the AG2 chat endpoint as a header, but the header never arrives.
The backend log is four oh one unauthorized on every run, so you can't get an authenticated run at all.
So umm, this one needs fixing, please look into it.
